description: Source file implementing a comprehensive PermissionManager for macOS applications, handling various permissions like notifications, accessibility, screen recording, microphone, speech recognition, camera, and location, with auxiliary helpers and a permission monitor.

classes.name: LocationPermissionRequester
classes.description: Handles requesting location permission asynchronously with manual continuation and timeout handling.

classes.name: PermissionMonitor
classes.description: Observes and manages the current permission statuses, periodically checking permissions and notifying observers.

classes.name: AppleScriptPermission
classes.description: Manages checking and requesting automation permissions for AppleScript execution.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the location authorization status qualifies as authorized.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Ensures specified capabilities are authorized, optionally interactively.

methods.name: ensureCapability
methods.description: Internal method that checks and requests specific capabilities.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Polls current status for various permissions.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the system settings page for specific privacy or security categories.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests location permission asynchronously with timeout.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes location permission request with final status.

methods.name: locationManagerDidChangeAuthorization
methods.description: Delegate callback for authorization status change.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if AppleScript automation permission is granted.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Triggers permission dialog for AppleScript automation.
